abilities.name: Big Mouth
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for a friendly Mega-Gargant
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly Gargant unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: More Stuff for Me Collection
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Unique Sons of Behemat Hero that does not have an artefact of power.
abilities.effect: Give that Hero 1 artefact of power from 'Titanic Trophies'. Designer's Note: *This artefact of power is given to the unit during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

abilities.name: Besieging Bulk
abilities.effect: Friendly Mega-Gargants have Ward (6+) while they are within the combat ranges of any other friendly Mega-Gargants.

abilities.name: Revel in War
abilities.effect: You can pick 2 friendly Mega‑Gargants or Gargant units that have not used a Rampage ability this turn to use the 'Jump Up and Down' ability instead of 1.

abilities.name: Strike! Hur Hur!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly Mega-Gargant units within 3" of any terrain features and pick any friendly Gargant units within 3" of any terrain features to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Double the Attacks characteristic of each target's ranged weapons for the rest of the turn. If the target has no ranged weapons, pick an enemy unit within 12" of the target instead and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Lofty Louts
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Mancrusher Gargant unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Gargant units while they are wholly within 12" of the target and not wholly within 12" of any friendly Mega-Gargant units.

abilities.name: Colossal Slam
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Mega‑Gargant that has not used a Rampage ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy Monster or War Machine that has a unit size of 1 and is within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the unit using this ability. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Gargant Charge
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Mega-Gargant or Gargant unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit that has not been picked as the target of this ability this turn and that is in combat with that unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Timberrrrr!
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly Mega‑Gargant or Gargant model is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

abilities.name: Jump Up and Down
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Mega‑Gargant or Gargant unit that has not used a Rampage ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy Infantry unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. If the unit using this ability is a Gargant, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 6. If it is a Mega-Gargant, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 5+.

abilities.name: Earthshaking Roar
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Mega‑Gargant or Gargant unit that has not used a Rampage ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Scything Blade
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot use Charge or Fight abilities. In addition, when this Manifestation moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing

summon.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Mechanisms of Time
